name: pressure-transmutations
of: A mechanism by which load on a person appears as a form somewhere else with a shape of its own, a skill, an illness, a joke, a cruelty, a business, a silence, a rule, named with the carrier that routes it, what the form does with the load, spend it, hold it, grow it, move it to another body, or outlive it, and, where one exists, the tell that says which.
items: Beat: a continuous load nobody could carry whole is cut into units each of which can be, and the cut is kept by a pulse, as the shanty turns a haul that would not end into a hundred pulls that each do, a monthly payment turns an unpayable sum into a payable one, and the prisoner counts days rather than the sentence; carried by the period rather than by any strength, and the form has a life of its own, since the song is sung ashore; it spends the load one unit at a time, and the load returns whole only if the pulse stops before the haul is done.

Anecdote that wears smooth: the thing that happened is told, and each telling files an edge until the story has a shape that can be told by someone who was not there, as the veteran's night under fire becomes, by the fortieth telling, a dinner story with a laugh in it; carried by the retelling, and the load is spent in the filing, since a story that has become about a character is no longer about the teller; not the silence, which is the same event held by never being told, and the tell that this one is spent is that the teller can now be interrupted.

Gallows round: a joke is built ahead of the moment and passed around a crew, so that when the load arrives it lands in a container two or ten can hold at once, as night nurses and bomb-disposal teams keep a stock of lines that outsiders find monstrous; carried by the joke's being shared rather than by its being funny, and the form has a shape of its own, since the lines are kept and taught to new hands; it spends what the crew can laugh off together and returns the remainder to each member alone, which is why the round is loudest on the wards with the most to hold; not the timing of the volatile house, which is one person's skill, and not the funeral laugh, which is overflow with nothing built for it.

Bill on release: the body keeps the account while the load is on, because settling it would cost the person the hours they need, and presents it the day the load lifts, as the migraine that arrives the morning after the deadline, the fever on the first day of the holiday, the shaking that begins only once the car has stopped; carried by deferral, and the form is an illness with a calendar; it spends the load in one payment, so what it shows is the cost of the vessel that was holding it, which is why the bill is largest after the longest hold; not the body's no, which comes during the load and lifts with it.

Second self: a character is grown to stand where the load lands so the person does not have to, the ward voice, the stage name, the manager's face, as a shy man keeps a persona who is not shy whom the audience meets while he watches from behind it; carried by the split, and the form is a person other people know; it holds the load rather than spending it, so the bill is paid on the day the persona is set down, and a persona kept up long enough is held against its own bill rather than against anything in the world; not the silence, which hides the load, since the persona is on show.

Fear with a ledger: a fear that would otherwise wander is given a place where it can be satisfied, and there it does the work, checking every column twice, as an accountant raised in a house where mistakes were dangerous is the most exact in the firm and could not tell you why; carried by the fear itself, which is the worker, and the form is a competence others pay for; it holds the load and keeps it working, so the retired accountant counts the change twice at the grocer's, since the fear is in the person and the ledger was only where it was put, and the bullied boy's shoulders are the same worker in a different tissue; not an amulet, where the load rides in an object and comes back whole when the object is lost.

Last acre: when the domain a person can order shrinks, the ordering does not shrink with it, and all of it lands on what is left, as a prisoner's cell is kept with a precision no free house has, a man three years out of work keeps a lawn the neighbors photograph, a woman who has lost the say over her days gets the say over her kitchen; carried by the shrinkage of the domain, and the form is an order out of all proportion to what it orders; it holds the load, and the tell is that the order relaxes when the domain widens, which is how it is told from fear with a ledger, where the exactness follows the person into the new job.

The body's no: where a refusal cannot be said, the body says it in the only tender the household or the army accepts, as a conscript whose leg will not bear him on the morning of the march, a daughter whose stomach will not keep food in the house she may not leave; carried by the list of excuses the setting honors, so that the sickness takes the shape of what is allowed, and the form is an illness with a purpose that no one, least of all the sick, has chosen; it holds the load, since the body recovers when the march is cancelled and relapses when it is set again; described from what the household sees, as a phenomenology and not a cause; not the bill on release, which arrives after the load and does not return with it.

Silence with a shape: the load is held by never being spoken, and the not-speaking acquires a shape everyone in the house can trace, the war that is not mentioned, the brother who is not named, the year with no photographs, as the immigrant who stops speaking the language the loss was in; carried by the closed channel, and the form is a topic with edges the household walks around without being told where they are; it holds the load for many in one person, so that when the silence is broken the load does not return to the silent one but lands on the hearers; not the anecdote, which is the same event spent by telling.

Vow that was a verdict: a loss that was imposed is redescribed as chosen and then kept as a rule, so that it is lived as a value rather than suffered as a sentence, as the surgeon demoted to orderly on arrival becomes the most devout man in the parish, and the woman who was not married takes up a celibacy she then honors; carried by the redescription, and the form is a discipline that is actually kept and does real work; it holds the load, and the tell is that the loss returns as loss the day the doctrine is doubted; not piety as such, since what is transmuted is the authorship of the loss.

Grudge battery: the load is given a name and a face and stored as a wrong done by someone, which turns a weight into a charge that can be kept indefinitely and drawn on, as the prisoner who lives fifteen years on the plan for the man who informed; carried by the personification, and the form is an enemy; it holds the load and grows it, since a charge is topped up by every rehearsal, and it is spent only by revenge, after which the one who won the suit or the duel commonly collapses, since the store that was keeping them up is empty; not the vow, which cannot share a house with a wrongdoer.

Shop that dreads: the load is turned into output, and the output acquires dependents, so that the form which took the pressure begins to manufacture it, as the immigrant's dread becomes a restaurant and the restaurant becomes a payroll, a lease, and a Friday it cannot miss; carried first by the deadline's conversion of dread into units and then by the units' dependents, and the form is an institution with a hunger of its own; it grows the load, since stopping returns the pressure with interest and in the names of the staff; not the ledger, which holds one person's fear in one person's hands.

Hunting the fuel: a form built under load runs only under load, so when the load lifts the person goes and finds some, as the writer who cannot write without a deadline makes one and then misses it, the discharged soldier who takes the night shift on the locked ward, the retired negotiator who picks fights with the parish council; carried by the form's operating condition rather than by any craving for the pressure, and the form is a life arranged around resupply; it grows the load by recruiting it, and the tell is that the form runs at full quality under a manufactured pressure, which is how it is told from a broken form.

Downhill delivery: the load is handed by an act to someone with less standing, as a sergeant who has taken the colonel's weather gives it to the private, the manager's dread arrives in the team as a schedule, the beaten child kicks the dog; carried by the status gradient, and the form is a cruelty that seems to belong to the deliverer's character; it moves the load without spending it, and it works, which is why it is stable, since the deliverer is lighter and the receiver has a gradient of their own below; not the lightning rod, which needs no act.

Lightning rod: a group's load lands on one member without anyone delivering it, because the structure routes it there, as a marriage's strain appears in one child's body and not the other's, a platoon's fear settles on the one everyone rides, the department's dread collects on the new hire; carried by the structure, the least-defended place, and the form is a role, the sick one, the clown, the problem; it moves the load and keeps it moved, so that a rod removed is replaced within the season, and the household that loses its sick child finds another; not downhill delivery, which is an act with an author.

Cornered generosity: what is about to be taken is given away first, so that a loss becomes a gift, as the bankrupt buys the whole bar a round, the dying give away the furniture, the potlatch host burns what a rival would otherwise outbid; carried by authorship, since a thing given is a thing one had the say over, and the form is a largesse strangers admire; it moves the load into obligation, since a gift makes a debtor where a seizure would have made only a loss, so the cornered giver ends the night poorer and owed; not a spender in this map's sense, though it spends money, since the load is now held by the people it was given to.

Timing from the volatile house: a child of a dangerous parent learns to read a room's temperature in half a second and to land the line that breaks the tension before the tension breaks something, and the skill outlives the house as comic timing, as the comedian who can feel a room turn and knows to the syllable when the joke must arrive; carried by the anticipatory reading, and the form is a skill strangers pay for without knowing what it was for; it neither spends nor holds the load, since the house is gone, and is a fossil in the kitchen until a room supplies danger again, as the hostile club does, where it becomes a form that hunts its fuel; not the gallows round, which is a crew's shared container.

Tin of string: a rule made under a load is kept when the load is gone, as the grandmother who lived through the hunger years keeps a tin of string too short to use, the newly rich founder who still cannot leave food on a plate, the demobbed man who cannot sit with his back to a door; carried by the rule's having been learned as a rule rather than as a response, and the form is a habit with nothing behind it; it outlives the load, so removing the form returns nothing, which is the one test this map has for telling a fossil from a vessel: throw the tin out, and if nothing comes back it was a tin; not fear with a ledger, where the fear is still working.

source.register: Analytical and phenomenological: described from what the person, the household, the ward, or the crew can see; cases from comedians, accountants, conscripts, night nurses, sergeants, prisoners, immigrants, the long-unemployed, the newly rich, a ship's crew, a potlatch; no clinical vocabulary and no claim about cause.
source.mode: Analytical mechanisms with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one carrier. The fate assigned to each form (spend, hold, grow, move, outlive) is an authored reading of the typical case, not a property of the form, and the edges show forms changing fate. The body's no is phenomenological description of a contested pattern and not a diagnosis; the hydraulic language throughout is a figure; no item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored phenomenology, not a clinical taxonomy: no item is a diagnosis or a claim about cause, and the two illness items describe what the person and the household can see, a calendar and a shape, not an etiology.

The fate assigned to each form (spend, hold, grow, move, outlive) is an authored reading of the typical case, not a property of the form; the edges show forms changing fate, and the itinerary is not a scale of severity or an order a person passes through.

The only test the map offers, remove the form and see what comes back, cannot be run on some forms (a body, a skill), is itself a load, and a form removed from its pressure may go and find more; so the conserve-or-spend question is answered here as a set of tells, not a measurement.

The hydraulic language (load, vessel, spend, charge) is a figure kept for what it lets one notice; no claim is made that pressure is a conserved quantity, and Downhill delivery and Lightning rod describe conservation within a household or a crew only as what an observer of that group sees.

Illustrative cases (the comedian, the accountant, the sergeant, the shanty, the potlatch, the demoted surgeon) are simplified composites exposing one carrier each, not claims about specific persons or histories; forms adopted deliberately as technique are outside except where the chosen form later acquires the mechanism.

seriation.axis: What the form does with the load: from forms that spend it (a beat, a retelling, a shared round, a bill paid on release), through forms that hold it and give it back when removed (a persona, a ledger, a last acre, a body's no, a silence, a vow), to forms that grow it (a grudge, a shop, a form that hunts its fuel), to forms that move it into another body or another's obligation (delivery, the rod, the cornered gift), and finally forms that outlive it (a timing with no house behind it, a tin of string), where removing the form returns nothing.
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of severity or a sequence a person passes through, and the fate at each stop is the typical one rather than a property of the form. Beat opens it because nothing is left of the haul but the song; Tin of string closes it because nothing is left behind the form at all. Bill on release → Second self is the hinge: the bill is a spender, one payment on the day the load lifts, but it is the vessel's cost, and once the bill is known the persona is kept up to avoid it, so a spender is what turns a vessel permanent, and the two halves of the walk meet in one household on one morning. Timing from the volatile house sits beside Tin of string rather than among the skills because with the house gone it is a fossil, and its edge to Hunting the fuel says how a fossil is resupplied. The illness items are split by the walk on purpose: The body's no holds and sits among the vessels, Bill on release spends and sits among the spenders, so a household reading one sickness can ask which side of the hinge it is on by its calendar.

exploration.first_question: By what carriers does load on a person appear as a form elsewhere with a shape of its own, a skill, an illness, a joke, a cruelty, an output, a silence, a piety, a precision, a business, a grudge, a body, and which of those forms conserve the load so that it returns when the form is removed, and which spend it?
exploration.changed_question: Breath one assumed a live load behind every form and sorted forms into conserving and spending. Sorting the admitted items by that question showed the fate is not fixed by the form: a persona spends until its bill makes it a vessel, a ledger holds one fear until dependents make it a generator, and the timing of the volatile house has nothing behind it at all and is a fossil until a room resupplies it. The question became what the form does with the load, spend, hold, grow, move, or outlive it, and how one could tell, since the only test is to remove the form, some forms cannot be removed, and a form removed from its load may go and find more.
exploration.new_member: Tin of string: a rule made under a load is kept when the load is gone, as the grandmother who lived through the hunger years keeps a tin of string too short to use, the newly rich founder who still cannot leave food on a plate, the demobbed man who cannot sit with his back to a door; carried by the rule's having been learned as a rule rather than as a response, and the form is a habit with nothing behind it; it outlives the load, so removing the form returns nothing, which is the one test this map has for telling a fossil from a vessel: throw the tin out, and if nothing comes back it was a tin; not fear with a ledger, where the fear is still working.

priorities.item: Fear with a ledger: a fear that would otherwise wander is given a place where it can be satisfied, and there it does the work, checking every column twice, as an accountant raised in a house where mistakes were dangerous is the most exact in the firm and could not tell you why; carried by the fear itself, which is the worker, and the form is a competence others pay for; it holds the load and keeps it working, so the retired accountant counts the change twice at the grocer's, since the fear is in the person and the ledger was only where it was put, and the bullied boy's shoulders are the same worker in a different tissue; not an amulet, where the load rides in an object and comes back whole when the object is lost.
priorities.why: It is the vessel most people already have and can vary on themselves, and it carries the map's test in its own discriminator: whether the fear is the worker or is riding in the check decides whether the competence survives the check's removal, which is the question a freelancer or a nurse asks every time they consider trusting themselves without the double-count.
priorities.next_question: Pick one competence you suspect is fear doing the work, the re-read, the second count, the check of the locked door, and for one week withhold the check on a task where an error would be cheap; record each day whether the exactness continued without the check (the fear is in you and working) or dread appeared in the check's place (the load was riding in the check, an amulet), and whether either changed by the fifth day.

priorities.item: Hunting the fuel: a form built under load runs only under load, so when the load lifts the person goes and finds some, as the writer who cannot write without a deadline makes one and then misses it, the discharged soldier who takes the night shift on the locked ward, the retired negotiator who picks fights with the parish council; carried by the form's operating condition rather than by any craving for the pressure, and the form is a life arranged around resupply; it grows the load by recruiting it, and the tell is that the form runs at full quality under a manufactured pressure, which is how it is told from a broken form.
priorities.why: Low plausibility that it is as general as it looks, high generative promise: it reverses the map's own test, since a form removed from its load may go and buy more, and if that is common then half the vessels on the walk are generators in waiting, and 'burnout' and 'boredom' in the same person may be one form at two fuel levels.
priorities.next_question: Take a form of yours that has stopped running, a kind of writing, a craft, a nerve for a room, and manufacture the pressure it was built under, a reader who will be hostile, a date with a real cost, and note whether the form returns at its old quality inside the manufactured pressure; if it does, write down what the pressure cost to buy and whether it would be cheaper to rebuild the form to run without fuel than to keep buying it.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference

neighbors.left: Fear with a ledger: a fear that would otherwise wander is given a place where it can be satisfied, and there it does the work, checking every column twice, as an accountant raised in a house where mistakes were dangerous is the most exact in the firm and could not tell you why; carried by the fear itself, which is the worker, and the form is a competence others pay for; it holds the load and keeps it working, so the retired accountant counts the change twice at the grocer's, since the fear is in the person and the ledger was only where it was put, and the bullied boy's shoulders are the same worker in a different tissue; not an amulet, where the load rides in an object and comes back whole when the object is lost.
neighbors.right: Last acre: when the domain a person can order shrinks, the ordering does not shrink with it, and all of it lands on what is left, as a prisoner's cell is kept with a precision no free house has, a man three years out of work keeps a lawn the neighbors photograph, a woman who has lost the say over her days gets the say over her kitchen; carried by the shrinkage of the domain, and the form is an order out of all proportion to what it orders; it holds the load, and the tell is that the order relaxes when the domain widens, which is how it is told from fear with a ledger, where the exactness follows the person into the new job.
neighbors.separating_case: An accountant three years out of work keeps immaculate household books. Give him the domain back with a job: under Last acre the household books relax as the domain widens, because the ordering was the whole person's ordering landing on the one acre left; under Fear with a ledger the exactness continues at the job and at home alike, because the fear is the worker and the acre was incidental. Same books, and the widening of the domain separates them, which is why the acre's tell is the relaxation and the ledger's tell is the grocer's change.

checks.boundary_case: The wrong valve is out: the laugh at the funeral, the tears at the desk, the rage at the spilled milk, where the load exits through whichever channel is open and in its own shape. Nothing has a shape of its own on the far side, so it is release, not transmutation. Gallows round is in on exactly that contrast, since the joke was built before the moment and can be held by two, and the map's edge from Silence with a shape says that a broken silence with no round on the far side gets the wrong valve.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the walk conceals: Bill on release → Second self, where the spender that is the vessel's cost is what makes the vessel permanent, so the two halves of the itinerary are one household on one morning. It shows two passages between levels: Fear with a ledger → Shop that dreads, where a trait acquires dependents and becomes an institution, and Silence with a shape → Gallows round, where one person's held load lands on a group and needs a group's container; these add to passages-between-levels the carrier by which a person's load becomes a group's. It shows an incompatibility between neighbors on the walk, Vow that was a verdict and Grudge battery, which cannot hold the same load, since a charged loss cannot be a chosen one. It shows a fork at every receiver, Downhill delivery → Lightning rod, where an act becomes a role if the gradient stays and a chain if it does not. And it shows a reversal of the map's own test, Timing from the volatile house → Hunting the fuel, where a fossil resupplied becomes a generator, so that removing the form is not a one-way probe.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each admitted item names a distinct carrier and a distinct fate, and the strange members (a skill that is a fossil until a room feeds it, a generosity that buys a debtor, a body that files a refusal in the household's own tender, a rule with nothing behind it that is the map's only instrument) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about coping.
